text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Once again, welcome. To our circus.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Today, I’ve prepared something special. The Fuji Kiseki you admire—one you’ve never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: For example, a side of me I don’t usually show... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Even the me all dressed up like this. I’ll show you that, and beyond that... I want to reveal a new me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now then, be captivated. The magic show begins.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Mmm... then let’s organize the issues. 'Staff' and 'Safety.' The first problem to address should be 'Staff,' correct?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Staff, huh... Thanks to the mini-circus, Flash and the others have joined, but hmm... efficiency isn’t great, is it?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hey☆ Then how about we use a livestream or school broadcast to call out, 'Hey! Let’s do a circus★'?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A livestream... yes, that could work. But will they really come just from that call?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. In that case, could you leave it to me? I’ve always wanted to try it—doing a live magic show!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Here, I’ll hide the camera for just a moment... Hmm, no, that might let some people figure it out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let’s check for a moment. Could you stop the recording?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Aha, interesting. So that’s how it looks. Livestreaming really makes you think about different things, doesn’t it?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: So, so? Does it look like it’s going well? The real thing’s tomorrow though!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm, the success rate still looks low. Even for me, this isn’t my usual well-practiced magic, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But... hehe. No problem. If I still have one more day, that’s more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha☆ Got it! If Fuji says that, then it’ll definitely be fine★

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, of course. You can expect great things. That’s what I’m here for.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: To all the gathered ponies and everyone attending—hello. It’s your Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: 'A magic stream?' 'What kind of tricks!?' ...Hehe, no need to rush. I’ll make sure to give you something truly worth watching.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Do you know where I am right now? That’s right, Tracen Academy. But once I snap my fingers—3, 2, 1!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Aha! What a nice day! Hello, Mr. Cow! The air is so fresh here!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: 'No way...' 'This has to be pre-recorded, right?' Heh, I totally get why you’d think that. But... are you sure about that?

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text: 'Wait... why did she read my comment!?' 'Ah! (shock)' 'If it was recorded, she couldn’t read it!' 'No way...'

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: 'Isn’t the background fake?' ...Ahaha, what a funny thing to say! Look, see for yourself! Does this cow look fake to you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That’s it! I’ll feed the cow now. Wait right there, I’ll go buy some food.

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text: 'Huh... the video just flickered for a sec...'

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I’m back! ...Huh, where am I now? I just went to get some food for the cow.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Uh, hey, I’m seeing her in a completely different place now!? What kind of trick is this!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That’s all for today’s performance. Hehe, did you enjoy it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: 'That was amazing!' 'Best show ever!' 'I want to see it again!' ...Thank you! I’m happy if I moved your heart, even a little—and I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Please, join me. Let’s move even more hearts together.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Okaaay☆ Those who want to join, line up over here! Form a line, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, Fuji! I saw your stream! Watching it made me want to help out!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: M-me too...! It’s not exactly payback for what I got, but... it looked so fun, so... yes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you, ponies. Your feelings make me happy. Let’s do our best together from here on!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I watched it as well... and honestly, it was thrilling. It was full of playful creativity, and I was completely absorbed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I did it! I’m glad if it looked like I was challenging myself, even a little.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That was the theme of this stream, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It’s a good opportunity, and I think it’s time I show it—a version of me taking on a higher challenge, one beyond what everyone expects.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The me who does even more than people say 'Fuji can handle this much'—that’s what makes me Fuji Kiseki, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So don’t take your eyes off me. Because tomorrow, and the day after tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I’ll become a version of myself you can’t take your eyes off.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Heeey☆ Could it be, Fuji’s reason for doing the circus is that too? A new challenge! You want to take one on?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that’s right! On the circus stage, I can test myself—that’s what I thought.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marveeeloos☆★☆ That’s awesome★ Fuji’s fired up!! With that attitude, there’s no way we can fail!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you’re so eager. ...But yeah, let’s make it a success, for sure.
